resolution: A mental occurrence or its physical realizer is a vehicle; the content is what is truth-evaluated. Reductive classifies the target kind as physical, not its content as a physical property instantiated by its bearer. No step from representation of a stone to being a stone, or from occurrence identity to content being about the occurrence, is licensed. Both structures share the same occurrence carrier and designated mental-kind predicate. This fixes a comparison profile; it does not identify these tokens with all q.75 intellectual operations.
